Question 4
?

Which of the following is equivalent to tanh⁡(1t), for t≠0?

a
e2/t−1e2/t+1
b
2e1/t−12e1/t+1
c
e2t−1e2t+1
d
e2/t+1e2/t−1
e
e2t+1e2t−1
Submit
